meaning.summary: Offer amused, smug disbelief at a statement or outcome.

meaning.summary: A wait has become absurdly long.

meaning.avoid_when: A friend offers exactly the option you requested and you accept happily; disgust would communicate the opposite.

meaning.summary: Use when one conspicuously foolish, weak, or unserious member stands out among otherwise formidable peers.
meaning.use_when: Label two polished product features as the fierce heads and the crash-prone settings page as the goofy third head.
meaning.avoid_when: All members of the group are equally competent, so singling one out as the defective head would be arbitrary.

meaning.summary: Use when someone accepts, selects, buys, or approves something immediately and with emphatic enthusiasm.
meaning.use_when: A friend asks whether the group wants an extra day off after the launch, and everyone replies with this button slap.
meaning.avoid_when: The proposal needs careful legal review before any decision; instant approval would misrepresent the hesitation.

meaning.summary: Use when rules, scores, roles, or stated facts are arbitrary, invented, or ultimately irrelevant to the outcome.
meaning.use_when: Your office awards points for meeting attendance but never uses them for anything, so the team compares it to this show.
meaning.avoid_when: A tournament's score determines who advances under published rules; the points materially matter.

meaning.summary: Use to celebrate breaking free from an oppressive obligation, restriction, dependency, or source of frustration.
meaning.use_when: After the team retires a tool everyone hated maintaining, a developer posts this to celebrate liberation from it.
meaning.avoid_when: A person refuses a reasonable safety boundary that protects others; framing that refusal as heroic freedom would distort the issue.

meaning.summary: Use when someone looks around for a person, object, explanation, or expected activity that is conspicuously absent.
meaning.use_when: You join the scheduled video call on time and find nobody else there, so you send this in the team chat.
meaning.avoid_when: You know exactly where everyone is and are simply waiting for them; the searching confusion would be false.

meaning.summary: Use immediately after a bad choice backfires, especially when the regret is obvious and the consequences are already chasing you.
meaning.use_when: Seconds after volunteering to coordinate the reunion, fifty relatives begin sending conflicting requests, and you post this.
meaning.avoid_when: An unavoidable accident happens despite a careful decision; calling it your mistake would assign responsibility inaccurately.

meaning.summary: Use to one-up a displayed mistake, failure, or extreme behavior by revealing an even more spectacular version.
meaning.use_when: A friend says they missed one deadline, and you reply with the time you missed an entire registration window: 'Amateurs.'
meaning.avoid_when: Someone asks a beginner for help learning a skill; belittling them offers no humorous escalation and is needlessly hostile.

meaning.avoid_when: Both friends eagerly trade stories and ask follow-up questions; mutual conversation is not the template's imbalance.

meaning.summary: Use as a direct recruitment or call to action aimed at the viewer or a specifically named person.
meaning.use_when: The volunteer group still needs one event photographer, so its organizer posts this with 'I want you to bring a camera.'
meaning.avoid_when: A general announcement provides information without asking anyone to act; the pointed recruitment gesture would add a demand.

meaning.summary: Use when a loud, persistent person or thing keeps intruding on someone who wants to be left alone.

meaning.avoid_when: The explanation reassures the listener and reduces their concern at every step; the fear escalation is absent.

meaning.summary: Use to show two people, groups, or concepts bonding over a shared trait, deal, victory, or point of agreement.

meaning.summary: Use when someone's questionable behavior seems to be observed by a moral authority, conscience, or disapproving presence.

meaning.avoid_when: A person openly performs a generous act they have no reason to hide; implied moral suspicion would not fit.

meaning.summary: Use for a complete emotional collapse when bad news, loss, guilt, or accumulated pressure finally becomes unbearable.
meaning.use_when: After weeks of revisions, a client asks the team to restore the very first draft, and the designer replies with this breakdown.
meaning.avoid_when: Someone is mildly annoyed by a typo and fixes it in seconds; the scale is far below a genuine collapse.

meaning.summary: Use when someone escapes, departs, or carries on looking composed while chaos erupts behind them.
meaning.use_when: A contractor submits the final files and begins vacation just as the client starts a chaotic revision thread, prompting this reaction.
meaning.avoid_when: A colleague stays behind to manage the emergency and accepts responsibility; the carefree getaway framing would misstate their role.

meaning.summary: Use for repeatedly checking a place despite already knowing that nothing new or useful will be there.
meaning.use_when: You refresh an empty inbox five seconds after the last refresh and send this to acknowledge the compulsion.
meaning.avoid_when: A notification confirms that a requested message has arrived; checking now has new information and is not futile repetition.

meaning.summary: Use for mock-philosophical reflection on a question that sounds profound but is often trivial, absurd, or obvious.

meaning.avoid_when: A team is carefully analyzing a difficult ethical decision with real consequences; treating it as faux wisdom could trivialize the work.

meaning.summary: Use when an attack, criticism, challenge, or supposed advantage is stopped effortlessly by someone far stronger.

meaning.avoid_when: The challenge causes serious damage and forces a desperate recovery, so effortless invulnerability would be inaccurate.

meaning.summary: Use to impose an emphatic, categorical ban on a tempting option because its recurring downside is too dangerous or impractical.

meaning.avoid_when: A harmless stylistic preference is still under open discussion; invoking a disaster-backed absolute would overstate the evidence.

meaning.summary: Use when an idea, story, joke, or system contains one layer nested inside another, often recursively.
meaning.use_when: Your team schedules a meeting to plan the agenda for another planning meeting, and someone labels it meeting inception.
meaning.avoid_when: Two unrelated tasks happen side by side without one containing the other; mere complexity is not nesting.

meaning.summary: Use as a frustrated demand asking why someone will not perform an obvious, desired, or repeatedly requested action.

meaning.summary: Use when someone has built an elaborate theory from scattered details and explains the supposed connections with frantic certainty.
meaning.use_when: A coworker links meeting times, coffee orders, and calendar colors to prove a secret reorganization is coming, so the team posts this.

meaning.summary: Use when fate, danger, layoffs, illness, or another grim force appears to be selecting its next target from a group.

meaning.avoid_when: A transparent rotation assigns routine duties fairly; random ominous victim selection would mischaracterize the process.

meaning.summary: Use when two people, traits, products, or ideas combine to create a hybrid that contains recognizable parts of both.

meaning.avoid_when: One product simply replaces another without retaining any of its features; substitution is not fusion.

meaning.summary: Use when someone or something repeatedly swings between two opposite moods, opinions, states, or choices.

meaning.avoid_when: A person makes one considered change and then stays consistent; a single transition is not oscillation.

meaning.summary: Use to reveal the one thought, obsession, worry, or oddly specific subject occupying someone's mind beneath a calm exterior.
meaning.use_when: During dinner you keep thinking about whether you locked the office, so you label the skull with that intrusive concern.
meaning.avoid_when: A friend openly tells everyone exactly what they are considering; there is no hidden inner thought to expose.

meaning.summary: Use when someone believes merely declaring a status or outcome will make it legally or practically true.
meaning.use_when: A teammate says 'I declare this project finished' while half the checklist is open, and the group responds with this.
meaning.avoid_when: An authorized official completes the required procedure and then announces the result; the declaration has real force.

meaning.summary: Use as a compact visual for sudden panic, alarm, or horrified realization.
meaning.use_when: You remember at 11:58 p.m. that an assignment is due at midnight and send this to your study group.
meaning.avoid_when: Someone calmly prepares for a known deadline over several days; the abrupt panic reaction would exaggerate their state.

meaning.summary: Use when two people give incompatible answers about whether they are friends, exposing a one-sided or awkward relationship.
meaning.use_when: Two coworkers are asked whether they are best friends; one says yes and the other says no, so the team recreates this exchange.
meaning.avoid_when: Both people consistently describe the relationship the same way; there is no mismatch for the split answer.

meaning.summary: Use for self-deprecating loneliness, romantic exclusion, or the feeling that everyone else has companionship.
meaning.use_when: Your friends pair off for a couples' quiz and you are the only unpaired guest, so you send this to the chat.
meaning.avoid_when: You intentionally choose a quiet evening alone and feel content; solitude without sadness is not forever-alone despair.

meaning.summary: Use when a shown item, person, experience, or benefit looks so desirable that someone immediately requests one for themself.
meaning.use_when: A friend shares a photo of their company-issued nap pod, and you reply 'one please' to express envy.
meaning.avoid_when: You are negotiating the detailed specifications and quantity of a purchase; the minimal reaction cannot communicate those requirements.

meaning.summary: Use when a long-running irritation, uncertainty, or conflict is finally resolved and calm returns.
meaning.use_when: After the smoke alarm's low-battery chirp is finally fixed, your household chat posts this in relief.
meaning.avoid_when: The underlying problem remains active and everyone is merely ignoring it; avoidance is not genuine resolution.

meaning.summary: Use when one person arrogantly claims to embody an institution, group, rule-making body, or all legitimate authority.
meaning.use_when: The club president rejects a vote by saying their opinion is the club's opinion, prompting members to post this.
meaning.avoid_when: A spokesperson accurately reports a decision made through the group's normal vote; representation is not monopolized authority.

meaning.summary: Use to seize on someone's admission and show that it supports the conclusion they were resisting.

meaning.summary: Use to deliver a mock public-service lesson, moral, warning, or rule in the style of an educational character segment.
meaning.use_when: After a friend loses work by closing an unsaved file, post 'Sonic says: save before you quit.'
meaning.avoid_when: The topic requires nuanced professional guidance with important exceptions; a jokey one-line lesson would oversimplify it.

meaning.summary: Use to show that an entire friend group enthusiastically approves of, supports, or enjoys the same person or thing.
meaning.use_when: Your friends unanimously praise the colleague who always brings snacks, so you caption the group 'All my homies love Maya.'
meaning.avoid_when: The group is split and several members dislike the subject; claiming universal affection would erase the disagreement.

meaning.summary: Use to rank needs or desires from foundational priorities to an exaggerated, highly specific ultimate aspiration.
meaning.use_when: A student labels the pyramid from sleep and food at the base to 'professor cancels the exam' at the peak.
meaning.avoid_when: The items have no dependency or increasing importance and are simply listed alphabetically; a hierarchy would imply structure that is absent.

meaning.summary: Use when someone treats a person, object, brand, or idea with absurdly reverent devotion.
meaning.use_when: When the office's temperamental printer finally produces a perfect color proof, the designers jokingly bow to it with this image.
meaning.avoid_when: A person is sincerely discussing their religious practice; using an ironic worship template may be disrespectful and unclear.

meaning.summary: Use for jealous, possessive attachment to something a person treasures and refuses to share or surrender.
meaning.use_when: Your sibling asks to borrow the last piece of cake you saved, and you clutch the container while replying 'my precious.'
meaning.avoid_when: You happily offer an item to anyone who needs it; generosity is the opposite of Gollum-like possession.

meaning.summary: Use when someone belatedly recognizes an obvious object's identity or purpose after treating it in a misguided way.

meaning.summary: Use for a boss, editor, fan, or stakeholder repeatedly demanding one very specific kind of content or deliverable.

meaning.summary: Use for praise that is outwardly controlled but loaded with envy, rivalry, status comparison, or barely concealed insecurity.

meaning.avoid_when: You warmly congratulate a friend with no competitive subtext; a jealous appraisal would add an unintended edge.

meaning.summary: Use for a sudden, forceful, or uninvited entrance that startles people already inside a conversation or space.
meaning.use_when: A coworker unexpectedly appears in a quiet thread with the answer everyone was avoiding, and posts 'Here's Johnny.'
meaning.avoid_when: A host introduces the scheduled speaker at the agreed time; a normal entrance lacks the intrusive surprise.

meaning.summary: Use after reading something so incoherent, bizarre, offensive, or mentally taxing that ordinary confusion is insufficient.
meaning.use_when: A friend forwards a paragraph whose argument contradicts itself in every sentence, and you respond with this reaction.
meaning.avoid_when: The document is clear but you disagree with its conclusion; disagreement alone is not bewilderment at the text itself.

meaning.summary: Use when someone quietly retreats from an awkward, embarrassing, contentious, or unwanted situation.
meaning.use_when: You enter a chat just as two relatives begin arguing about politics, so you post Homer backing into the hedge and leave.
meaning.avoid_when: A teammate stays to mediate the conflict openly; they are engaging rather than disappearing.

meaning.summary: Use when one group urgently asks an ally for help and the relationship implies that the ally will answer.

meaning.avoid_when: A stranger demands unpaid work from someone with no relationship or obligation to them; reciprocity is missing.

meaning.summary: Use when an unexpected person, event, demand, or complication abruptly interrupts an otherwise ordinary situation.
meaning.use_when: A routine status meeting is suddenly joined by the chief executive, and someone messages that nobody expected the inquisition.
meaning.avoid_when: The agenda clearly announced the guest weeks ago; calling the arrival unexpected would ignore shared notice.

meaning.summary: Use when someone keeps going far beyond the expected stopping point, or abruptly decides to run away from the situation altogether.
meaning.use_when: A friend begins a short cleanup and reorganizes the entire apartment overnight, so the group compares their momentum to Forrest running.
meaning.avoid_when: Someone completes precisely the small errand they planned and stops; ordinary follow-through lacks the runaway scale.

meaning.summary: Use when people sharing a confined setting realize a confrontation is imminent and tension spikes before anyone acts.

meaning.summary: Use to declare that a habit, project, trend, hope, or running joke is decisively over.

A sleepy rabbit shuffles out of his burrow and lifts his head.
meaning.use_when: Starting a routine task before you feel fully awake.
meaning.avoid_when: An energetic entrance or a triumphant return.

meaning.summary: Bunny leans into a patch of flowers and takes a slow sniff.
meaning.use_when: A small pleasant break in an otherwise busy day.
meaning.avoid_when: Stress, disgust, or an interruption that ruins the moment.

meaning.summary: A butterfly settles above Bunny, who smiles and clasps his paws.
meaning.use_when: A modest, unexpectedly lovely thing makes your day.
meaning.avoid_when: Sarcastic approval or celebrating someone else’s disappointment.

meaning.summary: Bunny blinks, then looks up at the butterfly above his head.
meaning.use_when: A small unexpected detail breaks your concentration.
meaning.avoid_when: A huge fright or an angry outburst; this is a mild double take.

meaning.summary: Bunny pauses in the meadow and gives a flat, skeptical look.
meaning.use_when: An unconvincing explanation leaves you completely unmoved.
meaning.avoid_when: Full-on rage or wholehearted agreement.

meaning.summary: A smirking squirrel gives way to Bunny’s increasingly stern stare.
meaning.use_when: One more avoidable annoyance arrives after several others.
meaning.avoid_when: Actual harm or grief, or a harmless first misunderstanding.

meaning.summary: A cut from the grinning trio to Bunny’s stunned, uncertain look.
meaning.use_when: A new detail suddenly changes how you feel about the situation.
meaning.avoid_when: An uncomplicated win or a serious incident that needs support.

references.title: The group chat has a plan

meaning.summary: Three small forest characters exchange mischievous looks.
meaning.use_when: Your friends agree on something that looks suspiciously chaotic.
meaning.avoid_when: A solitary reaction or a serious plan that needs a straight answer.

meaning.summary: Bunny stands almost motionless with his paws held behind his back.
meaning.use_when: You are patiently waiting for someone else to make the next move.
meaning.avoid_when: Impatient pacing, panic, or a task that has already finished.

meaning.summary: Something drops past a wide-eyed bird, which looks straight ahead.
meaning.use_when: A strange, low-stakes event takes a moment to register.
meaning.avoid_when: A triumphant celebration or an actual threat that needs attention.

meaning.summary: A squirrel hangs in mid-air, notices the drop, and starts to fall.
meaning.use_when: An overlooked consequence catches up just as you realize the problem.
meaning.avoid_when: Real injury, an urgent safety question, or a consequence already anticipated.

meaning.summary: Bunny starts to smile, then a butterfly flutters right into his face.
meaning.use_when: You get one quiet moment before another small interruption.
meaning.avoid_when: Uninterrupted calm or completed work that stays finished.
